messages:
Asha K: Heads-up: NetBand sent an "overage" charge on our evaluation invoice for bandwidth between regions. amount looks ~10x our tracked bytes. @Ben T can you check?

Ben T: on it. paste invoice line?

Asha K: snippet: 
SKU: NB-BW-INTERREG
Unit: $0.12 / GB
Qty: 4500
Line total: $540.00
Note: eval-org replication 2025-02-11
Our ingress logs show ~45GB, not 4500GB.

Renee L: likely a multiplier bug (bytes vs MB vs GB). also confirm whether they bill chunked uploads as duplicate when retries occur.

Ben T: @procurement-bot please fetch NetBand metering export for org:redwood-eval-195001 and the invoice CSV.

procurement-bot: fetching artifacts... billing CSV: https://s3.company/billing/netband/netband-eval-195001.csv ; invoice: https://s3.company/billing/netband/invoice-195001.pdf :gear:

Ben T: pasted CSV sample: `event=transfer bytes=52428800 retries=0 units=1` repeated. units=1 per 50MB chunk. invoice must be interpreting units as GB.

Renee L: okay that explains 4500 units -> ~225GB, still mismatch but closer. two asks: (1) request vendor metering spec and chunk->GB conversion, (2) ask for corrected invoice or trial credit.

Asha K: procurement, please open ticket NB-PO-3121 asking for itemized conversion and immediate adjustment. cc finance@redwood so we can hold payment. if vendor refuses, pause renewal evaluation.

Ben T: created ticket NB-PO-3121 "Clarify inter-region bandwidth metering during eval". cc finance@redwood. vendor ETA 72h. Will update here. :spiral_note_pad:
